newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian c.bank assets rise 4.7 pct in November.
newsitem.headline: Estonian c.bank assets rise 4.7 pct in November.

text.p: The assets of the central bank of Estonia rose 4.7 percent in November to 8.739 billion kroons and its convertible foreign currency increased more than five percent to 7.6 billion kroons, the bank said on Monday.
The bank said in a statement that convertible foreign currency rose due to a rise in demand for base money and changes in exchange rates.

The bank also said money in circulation rose slightly in November to 4.69 billion kroons from 4.68 billion kroons the previous month. Gold and foreign currency reserves backing the kroon rose to 7.65 billion kroons from 7.26 billion kroons.
